column7: requireEqualOrGreaterAdminAuthority listed the target's scopes (GetUserRoleScopes) and then read the role set at each scope with separate reads, so a grant moved between those reads by another administrator (one commit: remove at project A, add at project B) was discovered at A and found absent there, and an actor who does not outrank the target passed. The target's role set at every scope now comes from one read (ListUserRoleGrants, direct and group grants with each role's bypass flag), and the scopes checked are GetUserRoleScopes' plus every scope that read lists a grant at (landed in #4106). The proving test moves the grant between the check's reads on the same store. TestAdminRankCeiling_ConcurrentScopeMoveSeenWhole_Postgres repeats it through a second connection pool (pg-gated, so not the proving test of this default-ci row); TestAdminRankCeiling_SnapshotVerdictUnchanged pins that the verdict is otherwise the old one. Not covered: the actor's side is still read per scope (INV-CORE-admin-rank-ceiling-target-roles-one-read).
